remarks: Tucked away in the sought-after Kingswood complex, this updated Georgian-style townhouse offers privacy, convenience, and exceptional commuter access just 0.25 miles from Merritt 7 train station. Set against a peaceful wooded backdrop, this move-in-ready home features cherry hardwood floors throughout and extensive owner updates, including the HVAC system, kitchen, and primary bath. The renovated kitchen boasts white cabinetry, textured quartz countertops, gas cooking, and a stylish coffee/wine bar. Sliding doors lead to a private deck perfect for outdoor dining and relaxation. The open main level features a dining area overlooking the spacious living room with a fireplace. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a beautifully updated bath with a glass-enclosed shower and a large walk-in closet, while a full hall bath serves a second bedroom. The lower level includes a built-in garage with interior access and flexible bonus space ideal for a home office, gym, or storage. Additional features include Ethernet wiring, smart thermostat, smart lighting, wireless security system, assigned parking, visitor parking, and access to the in-ground pool. Convenient to SoNo, the Norwalk River Valley Trail, Merritt Parkway, Route 7 Connector, and I-95.
